baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired قَرَّبَا/قُرْبَانًا and three ق ب ل forms culminate in مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both sons enter the same outward channel of devotional nearness, but reception divides them. The closing مِن construction relocates the decisive difference from the presented object to the protective orientation of the presenting person.

activation_trace.role: Devotion-directed nearness supplies the shared outward approach and offering.
Reception with satisfaction supplies the repeated relational uptake whose presence and absence divide the pair.
Putting the self in protection supplies the disposition named as the source from whom acceptance occurs.

changed_reading.before: One offering happened to be accepted and the other rejected.
changed_reading.after: The paired offering exposes acceptance as divine relational uptake conditioned by the offerer's protective moral orientation, not as an automatic property of presenting an object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِٱلْحَقِّ frames the one/other asymmetry, and the two قَالَ clauses answer a murder threat with an acceptance criterion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rejected brother converts unequal reception into a personal contest, while the reply removes adjudication from either brother's claim and states a general divine criterion. The truthful report therefore stages rival ways of deciding entitlement: coercive self-assertion versus a criterion neither rival controls.

activation_trace.role: A contest in which each side claims right supplies the latent dispute that the truthful narration adjudicates.
Negotiation over a matter supplies the paired speeches as competing proposals for resolving the asymmetry.
The enemy or matched adversary image supplies the threat's conversion of a brother into a rival to be eliminated.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports jealousy escalating into a threat.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts two jurisdictions: the rejected brother claims an outcome through force, while the accepted brother returns the dispute to a divine criterion of receptivity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱتْلُ governs نَبَأَ and بِٱلْحَقِّ before the tightly sequenced إذ/ف/ولم/قال/قال progression.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command does more than transmit an anecdote: its following image asks hearers to track a true report through successive transformations, from approach to unequal reception, then speech, threat, and criterion.

activation_trace.role: Following in succession supplies recitation as leading an audience along an ordered trace.
An arriving, consequential report supplies the transmitted event whose movement must be followed.
Stable correspondence to reality constrains the causal trace as truth rather than rumor.

changed_reading.before: Recite a true report about two sons.
changed_reading.after: Lead the audience along a truth-constrained causal trace showing exactly how an act of approach can turn into a crisis of reception and violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accepted brother's protective orientation becomes bodily and procedural: he refuses to extend his hand toward killing, whereas the other's own self makes killing easy and executable. Taqwa now reads as an internal brake that interrupts the translation of injury into outward force.

activation_trace.role: Reception with satisfaction is the outcome whose dispositional condition is being made visible.
A barrier that repels harm supplies taqwa as active interruption rather than a merely named status.
Extending and releasing the hand supplies the concrete action that one brother threatens and the other withholds.
Fear anticipating harm supplies the God-directed concern that blocks reciprocal killing.
The self's making an act easy supplies the opposite internal process: facilitation instead of restraint.
The self's force and character supplies the inner agent that rehearses violence into action.

structural_cues: 5:28 balances 'you extend your hand' against 'I am not extending my hand' with the same ب س ط construction.
5:30 then gives the opposed causal sequence: the self facilitates the killing, so he kills.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld hand-extension, God-directed fear, and self-facilitated murder; I infer that the protective disposition named in 5:27 works by interrupting action formation. A live alternative is that 5:28 describes nonretaliation without exhausting the meaning of taqwa.

changed_reading.before: God accepts from people bearing the label 'the Godwary.'
changed_reading.after: God accepts from people whose God-directed protection can halt the hand before grievance is converted into reciprocal violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's one/other division does not remain a private ritual comparison. Sin returns upon its bearer, literal killing targets a self, and the one slain self is analogically gathered into all people. The mishandled difference in acceptance becomes a mechanism for collective liability.

activation_trace.role: Individual separation supplies the accepted 'one' as a discrete member of the pair.
The other after or apart from the first supplies the relational asymmetry that violence misreads as exclusion.
Unequal reception supplies the initial difference whose social consequences are traced.
A thing returning upon its owner supplies wrongdoing as liability that rebounds rather than transferring cleanly.
Literal taking of life supplies the realized threat and the action generalized by the analogy.
The life-bearing self supplies the singular unit whose violation exceeds a private sibling dispute.
Wholeness without dispersion supplies 'all people' as the full social scale folded into one life.

structural_cues: 5:29 doubles 'my sin and your sin,' resisting a simple transfer of responsibility.
5:32 repeats the one-self/all-people analogy for both killing and giving life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rebounding liability and an explicit one-to-all analogy; I infer that 5:27's one/other comparison is the seed of a social mechanism in which private resentment damages the whole. The alternative is that 5:32 states only a legal valuation of life, not a reading of ritual rejection.

changed_reading.before: Two individuals receive different ritual outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a scale model: treating another's acceptance as one's own exclusion converts a bounded difference into violence whose liability reaches the human whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded following of the report becomes materially pedagogical. A search through earth reveals how concealed bodily consequence is handled; later, guidance itself advances by following prior traces. Recitation therefore makes hearers follow exposed and preserved effects, not merely receive propositions.

activation_trace.role: Following in succession supplies the focus command's trace-like movement.
The arriving consequential report supplies what the audience is led through.
Stirring earth to seek and uncover supplies discovery through a material trace.
Causing something to be seen supplies the raven scene as demonstrative instruction.
Covering something behind visibility supplies the consequence that must first be revealed in order to be concealed responsibly.
Following an effect in succession supplies the later transmission pattern that echoes the focus command.
A remaining mark that indicates what preceded supplies the preserved evidence along which guidance travels.

structural_cues: 5:31 repeats the purpose construction 'to show him how to conceal,' joining revelation to a practical consequence.
5:46 places following directly 'upon their traces,' turning succession into an explicit transmission image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies searching, showing, concealment, following, and remaining traces; I infer that وَٱتْلُ asks the audience to learn by tracking consequences through time. Literal vocal recitation remains the primary live alternative and need not be displaced.

changed_reading.after: Make the audience follow a preserved trail in which hidden consequences become visible and later guidance proceeds upon earlier traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's قربان is reclassified by the later sequence: accepted approach is a sought, effortful path under taqwa, while even the whole earth doubled as ransom cannot purchase reception. Quantity of transferred value and quality of approach are separated.

activation_trace.role: Devotional nearness and offering supply the focus's presented means of approach.
Reception with satisfaction supplies the outcome that cannot be reduced to transfer value.
Self-placement in protection supplies the qualitative orientation joined to accepted approach.
Seeking a thing supplies approach as active pursuit rather than possession.
Exerting capacity under difficulty supplies the costly movement along the sought way.
An extended traversable road supplies divine approach as a path of conduct.
Completion without remainder supplies the maximal quantity of earthly value offered.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the attempted transactional substitution.
The repeated passive non-reception explicitly denies that an earth-sized ransom can secure acceptance.

structural_cues: 5:35 places اتقوا, seek the branchless الوسيلة, and strive in one imperative sequence.
5:36 repeats the focus's passive ق ب ل plus مِن after maximizing the proposed ransom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sought way under taqwa and a maximal ransom that is not accepted; I infer a qualitative-versus-transactional contrast that retroactively classifies the قربان. A live alternative is that 5:36 concerns only the impossibility of post-judgment ransom.

changed_reading.before: The brothers transfer offerings, one of which receives approval.
changed_reading.after: The offering is a mode of approach: receptivity belongs to a protected path of conduct and cannot be bought by increasing the amount transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one/other acceptance asymmetry is placed beside differentiated ways, the counterfactual of one community, an explicit test, and a command to race toward goods. Difference in divine allotment becomes a test of response, not authorization for winner-take-all rank or elimination.

activation_trace.role: Individual separation supplies the 'one' distinguished by acceptance.
Otherness after or beside the first supplies the difference that the threat turns into rank.
Unequal reception supplies the comparative event whose proper response is at issue.
Making something into a state supplies differentiated pathways and the unrealized alternative of one community.
A manifest watering place supplies each assigned way as a usable approach rather than a badge of superiority.
A clear path supplies differentiated conduct with intelligible direction.
Singularity and separateness supply the counterfactual unity God did not impose.
A test that makes condition visible supplies the function of receiving different allotments.
Advancing in competition supplies the nonviolent response to difference.
Movement toward beneficial good supplies the field in which comparison should operate.

structural_cues: The focus's مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا/مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ is answered by 5:48's distributive لِكُلٍّ and counterfactual أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً.
5:48 moves directly from testing what each was given to فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated ways, a unity counterfactual, testing, and competition in goods; I infer that this sequence diagnoses the brother's fatal response to differentiated reception. The live alternative is that 5:48 concerns communities only and activates the focus by analogy rather than direct exposition.

changed_reading.before: Acceptance sorts the brothers into a winner and a loser.
changed_reading.after: Differentiated reception tests what each does with difference: the intended competitive field is good action, while murder is the failed attempt to abolish asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's بِٱلْحَقِّ expands from accurate reporting into an adjudicative discipline. Later actors displace words, accept only a preferred ruling, trade signs for price, and follow desire; the countermechanism is equitable judgment and enacted truth. The brother's threat is thus an early form of outcome-shopping by force.

activation_trace.role: Competing claims to right supply the sibling dispute that must be adjudicated outside either claimant's desire.
Turning something away from its direction supplies textual displacement as manipulation of the adjudicative channel.
Equity and fair apportionment supply the corrective judgment that does not bend to the parties.
Commercial exchange supplies the prohibited conversion of signs into negotiable outcome.
Price as exchange value supplies the small consideration for which truth can be compromised.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the book and received truth as the operative standard for judgment.
Following in succession supplies the forbidden act of letting judgment trail the parties' preferences.
The self's inclination supplies the pressure that truth-governed judgment must resist.

structural_cues: 5:41 reports the conditional policy 'if you are given this, take it; if not, beware,' making acceptance explicitly outcome-selective.
5:48 repeats بِٱلْحَقِّ and contrasts received truth with following desires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manipulated words, selective uptake, equitable judgment, price, truth, and desire; I infer that the focus threat is coercive rejection of an unwanted verdict. The alternative is that the later material regulates public adjudication without specifying the rejected brother's motive.

changed_reading.before: بِٱلْحَقِّ assures that the old story is accurately told.
changed_reading.after: بِٱلْحَقِّ installs a nonnegotiable adjudicative standard: the rejected brother's violence is an attempt to replace an unwelcome verdict with the outcome he wants.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection is not generalized risk avoidance. The accepted brother fears God and withholds violence; diseased hearts fear an adverse turn and rush into compromising alignment; the later faithful do not fear a blamer's blame. Taqwa is fear ordered toward the right object, freeing action from socially coercive fear.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self in protection supplies the disposition whose fear structure is clarified.
Anticipatory fear supplies the God-directed concern that restrains the hand.
Departure from health and balance supplies the disordered heart in which fear drives compromise.
Fear with apprehensive gravity supplies the stated motive for rushing toward protective affiliation.
An adverse turn or defeat supplies the feared contingency around which diseased hearts organize.
Hiding something inwardly supplies fear's concealed policy before it is exposed.
Regret over what has passed supplies the eventual disclosure that fear chose badly.
The same anticipatory fear is explicitly denied toward social blame.
Blame for a blameworthy act supplies the social pressure that rightly ordered fear can withstand.

structural_cues: 5:28 joins fear of God to refusal of reciprocal hand-extension.
5:52 joins fear of a reversal to rushing and concealed policy, while 5:54 negates fear of blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three differently directed fears and their opposed actions; I infer that taqwa orders fear rather than maximizing caution. The live alternative is that these passages describe separate virtues without defining one common fear mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The accepted are simply those who fear.
changed_reading.after: The accepted protect themselves by fearing the divine criterion more than retaliation, reversal, or social blame, and that ordering frees them from fear-driven violence and compromise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the guarantee branch is contract-like and form-distant from the ordinary verbal sense of acceptance. It remains anchored in the three ق ب ل forms and coheres with an offered object entering or failing to enter divine charge; downstream prose should present it only as an analogy, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated تُقُبِّلَ/يُتَقَبَّلْ/يَتَقَبَّلُ governs the fate of a قُرْبَان and is followed by a coercive threat.

activation_trace.role: The devotional offering supplies the object presented for relational uptake.
Guaranteeing and taking responsibility supplies an exploratory image of acceptance as taking the offering into charge.
Exposing another to killing supplies the rejected brother's attempt to force consequence when no guarantee is granted.

changed_reading.before: Acceptance means approval of an offering.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, acceptance means that the offering is taken into divine charge; denied that relation, the rejected brother tries to manufacture certainty through coercive consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The literal killing is explicit and confirmed, so it must not be allegorized away. The surprising branch remains useful because 5:30 supplies the self making the act easy before the killing occurs; downstream prose should describe an internal conditioning layer beneath the literal homicide.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ anchors the literal threat, while the same ق ت ل root recurs in its execution.

activation_trace.role: Taming until hardness yields supplies an exploratory image of coercion first worked upon the killer's own resistance.
The self's making the deed easy supplies the internal conditioning step that precedes execution.
The inward faculty of thought and apprehension supplies the site in which murder becomes acceptable to the agent.
Literal taking of life contains the exploratory layer by confirming the bodily act it serves.

changed_reading.before: The brother threatens and then performs a killing.
changed_reading.after: The literal killing includes a prior self-taming process: the agent's inner resistance is softened until lethal coercion becomes an executable act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy: حبط's harmful-food swelling is remote from ritual acceptance. It remains anchored because the focus asks why a presented work is not received and 5:53 explicitly joins حبط to works; downstream prose should mark the metabolic image as exploratory and retain the ordinary sense of works becoming null.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا followed by unequal ق ب ل makes the fate of a performed offering the focus problem.

activation_trace.role: Devotional offering supplies the work presented for uptake.
Reception with satisfaction supplies the relational metabolism that succeeds for one offering and fails for the other.
Swelling from harmful intake supplies the odd image of outward work entering a system but producing corruption rather than nourishment.
Purposive action supplies the deeds whose outward performance does not secure a viable result.

changed_reading.before: A performed offering is either approved or disapproved.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, nonacceptance resembles failed moral metabolism: outward work is presented, but its inward composition makes uptake corruptive or void rather than nourishing.

strongest_changes: 5:28-30 turns taqwa from a ritual label into a visible interruption of hand-extension and of the self's facilitation of violence.
5:35-36 makes accepted approach qualitative rather than purchasable: a sought path can be accepted where an earth-sized ransom is not.
5:48 recasts the one/other asymmetry as a test that should produce competition in goods instead of winner-take-all violence.
The judgment sequence turns بِٱلْحَقِّ into resistance to manipulated, desired outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly reactivates the focus's own architecture: approach versus ransom, acceptance versus selective uptake, one/other versus differentiated paths, truthful report versus manipulated judgment, and taqwa versus misdirected fear. These recurrences make the murder narrative a compact diagnostic model for ritual, legal, textual, and social receptivity without collapsing those domains into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 5:48's communal plurality is intended to retroact on the brothers or only provides a strong analogical activation.
Whether the guarantee, internal-taming, and metabolic branches should reach downstream prose beyond explicitly exploratory notes.
The focus states acceptance from the protected but does not disclose the offerings' material difference; the packet supports a dispositional filter without proving material irrelevance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Offered nearness must be met by receptive facing.** `ق ر ب B005` is devotional approach/offering and `ق ب ل B004` receiving with acceptance. Their repetition makes sacrifice a two-sided movement. I infer that the rejected brother mistakes presentation for guaranteed reception, then redirects failed approach into killing (`ق ت ل B001`).
2. **Protective caution is the condition of reception.** `و ق ي B001` supplies a barrier warding harm. I infer that acceptance depends on an offering emerging from a self already restraining harm; the threatened murder retrospectively exposes the missing condition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **An offered approach is tested by the disposition carrying it.** Repeated fixed **ق ر ب / B005** (“devotional approach and offering”) supplies the attempt to draw near, while repeated fixed **ق ب ل / B004** (“receiving with acceptance”) marks unequal reception. The prior story ends with a people barred from the land after refusing approach; the following ayat show one brother answering non-acceptance by closing distance violently. I infer that an offering cannot mechanically produce nearness when its bearer rejects the moral condition named at the end. The sacrifice reads as a relational approach whose acceptance discloses orientation, not as an object that compels return.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:30–5:32 showed how rejected approach mutates into murder, exposed remains, and finally a rule scaled to all people; non-acceptance was never only private disappointment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Violence turns intention into a visible body, after which concealment attempts to manage the material evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral incapacity is exposed not at the killing but at the inability to perform the basic material care demonstrated by a bird.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Hand Makes Killing Easy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The self smooths resistance until the hand can complete lethal action against a brother.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: killing `quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`; blood or life `quranic:root_001533:B004/m01`; hand as agent `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; the self making an act easy `quranic:root_000956:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lethal scene has an inward and outward instrument. The self first removes moral friction; the hand then converts that eased intention into a corpse.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın ana sözü, bir şeyin kendinden önce gelen şeyi izlemesi ve art arda gelme fikrini açıkça merkez yapar. Geçici çerçeve bunu bedensel, sıra ve makam bakımından izleme olarak doğru yakalar; borç kalanı, güvence ve terk etme gibi başka dallar bu çekirdeğe katılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın izleme biçimlerini hem de belirli kalıp kullanımları içerir; kalıplar yalın anlamı genişletmeden ayrı yüzeyler olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendinden önce gelen başka bir şeyi takip etmesi, onun ardından gelmesi veya aynı sırayı kesintisiz biçimde sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ya da eylem, önce gelen bir başka şeye bağlı olarak ardından gelir.
İzleme, fiziksel sıra kadar konum, derece ya da örnek alma düzeninde de kurulabilir.
Atların art arda gelişi, dalın kesintisiz sıralanma örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı izleme, ardından gelme ve art arda sıralanma etrafında birleştirir; özel kalıp örnekleri bu genel çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, küçük yer yükseltisi ve boyun adlarından yere serme, dökme, sarsma, güç niteliği ve özel kap anlamlarına; ayrıca kötü durum, uzanma, borç kalanı, ağız nemi, uyaklı pekiştirme ve damızlık arama gibi bağımsız alanlara yayılan belirgin çok anlamlı bir yapı gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخروج من أرض إلى أرض، والمجيء من بلد آخر، والطلوع على القوم، وما جاءت به الأرض.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi haberi temel anlam olarak verir; bazı kullanımlarda haberin önemli ve bilgi sağlayıcı olmasını, ayrıca haber verme ile haber isteme eylemlerini aynı dalın biçimleri olarak belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım haber adını çekirdeğe alır; bildirme, belirli bir şeyi bildirme ve haber isteme biçimlerini bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir olay veya durum hakkında iletilen haber, özellikle bilgi ya da güçlü bir kanaat sağlayacak ölçüde önemli haber anlamıdır. Birine haber vermek, belirli bir şeyi bildirmek ve birinden haber istemek bu çekirdeğe bağlı eylemlerdir.

facets.statement: Bir olay veya durum hakkında başkasına ulaşan bilgi içerikli haber söz konusudur.
Haber, önemli bir yarar taşıyıp bilgi veya güçlü bir kanaat oluşturabilir.
Haber verme, bir şeyi bildirme ve karşı taraftan haber isteme eylemleri aynı çekirdeğe bağlanır.
Haber verme biçimlerinden biri, başka bir bildirme biçimine göre daha güçlü anlatım sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tabanı haber ve haber vermedir. Toplu ifade ayrıca önemli haberin bilgi veya güçlü kanaat sağladığını, haber isteme biçimini ve iki bildirme biçimi arasında güç farkı bulunduğunu kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın haber çekirdeğini korur ve haberin bir olay ya da durum hakkında bilgi taşıdığını belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: İletilen içerik ile bu içeriğin haber niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İçeriğin yararlı olduğu ve bilgi ya da güçlü kanaat doğurduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin önemini ve alıcıda bilgi veya güçlü kanaat oluşturmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye olay veya durum hakkında bilgi iletme eylemi söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir haber içeriğini başka bir kişiye iletme eylemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işin iç yüzünü sınayarak öğrenme, deneyim ve uzmanlık anlamları da kapsanır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal haberden iç yüzü bilmeye ve deneyime uzanan daha geniş bir bilgi alanıdır; odak dal iletilen haber ve ona bağlı bildirme biçimleri çevresinde kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Haberin kendisi, önemi ve bir kişiden haber isteme eylemi de kapsam içindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haberi açıklayıp yayma ve onu geniş bir çevreye duyurma yönü belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir haber içeriğinin başkalarına ulaşmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal haberin kendisini ve kişiye bildirmeyi kapsar; komşu dal ise haberin açıklanıp çevreye yayılmasını temel olay yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Haberin kendisi ve onu başkasına bildirme eylemi temel kapsamdadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişide bulunan bilgiyi sınayarak araştırma ve haber soruşturma öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal haber isteme ve bilinmeyen bir içeriği öğrenme bağlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal araştırıp soruşturmayı çekirdek yapar; odak dalda haber isteme, haber ile bildirme çekirdeğine bağlı bir eylemdir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النبأ بمعنى الخبر، والأنباء، ونبأته وأنبأته واستنبأته، والنبأ العظيم ذو الفائدة والعلم أو غلبة الظن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النبأ الخبر (maqayis;ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ نبأته وأنبأته واستنبأته والجميع الأنباء (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ خبر ذو فائدة عظيمة يحصل به علم أو غلبة ظن (mufradat)؛ نبأته أبلغ من أنبأته (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النبي أو النبئ لأنه ينبئ عن الله، والنبوة بوصفها سفارة بين الله وعباده، لا مطلق الخبر البشري.
يدخل فيه تنبأ فلان بمعنى ادعى النبوة كذبا، ونبيئ سوء فيمن ليست أخباره من أخبار الله.
يدخل فيه قولهم رمى فأنبأ إذا لم يشرم ولم يخدش، كأن السهم عدل عن الخدش وسقط في موضع آخر.
يدخل فيه النبأة بمعنى الصوت أو الصوت الخفي أو النغية، وما كان صوتا ليس بالشديد.
يدخل فيه النبي بمعنى الطريق الواضح الذي يأخذك إلى حيث تريد، وموضع النبي من الكاثب أي ما سهل من الأرض.

branches.branch_image_ar: بناء الشيء بضم بعضه إلى بعض
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفعل بنى، والبناء والبنيان لما يبنى، وبناء البيت والدار والقصر والحائط والسماء، وإعطاء ما يبنى به البيت.
يدخل فيه البنية بمعنى الهيئة التي بني عليها الشيء، وصحيح البنية، والفطرة أو الخلقة المركبة.
يدخل فيه البنية اسما للكعبة أو بيت الله، وما ذكرته المصادر من تسمية مكة البنية.

branches.branch_image_ar: المَبْناة بيت أو غطاء من أدم
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المبناة كهيئة القبة أو الستر من أدم، والنطع أو الحصير أو العيبة، والبناء المبسوط في المطر أو على المتاع.
يدخل فيه القوس البانية أو باناة عند طيئ، وهي التي لزقت بوترها حتى يكاد ينقطع.

branches.branch_image_ar: بناء الرجل على أهله ودخوله بها
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بنى على أهله بمعنى زفها أو دخل بها، والباني بمعنى العروس، مع تعليل القبة التي تضرب عند الدخول.

branches.branch_image_ar: البُنُوَّة والنسب وما ينسب إلى منشأ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الابن والبنت والبنون والأبناء والبنات والبنوة، والتبني، وما يسمى ابنا أو بنتا لأنه يحصل من جهة شيء أو تربيته أو خدمته أو ملازمته.

branches.branch_image_ar: تسميات الابن والبنت للأشياء المتفرعة أو الصغيرة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بنيات الطريق للطرق الصغار، والبنات للتماثيل الصغار، وبنات المساجد للحصى، وبنت الأرض للحصاة، وابن الأرض للبقل.

branches.branch_image_ar: البَواني أضلاع ودعائم يستقر بها الشيء
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البواني لأضلاع الزور، والبوان أو البوائن لأعمدة البيت، وألقى بوانيه بمعنى أقام واطمأن.
يدخل فيه بنى لحم فلان طعامه إذا عظمه من الأكل أو سمنه.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bu dalı yanlışın karşıtı olan doğruluk, gerçekliğe uygunluk, kesin olarak bilme ve sözün gerçek anlamında kullanılması çevresinde kurar. Verilen dal kimliği bu ortak çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kullanımlar doğruluk ve gerçekliğe uygunluk çekirdeğini taşır; yemin bildiren kalıp yalnız kendi söz dizimi içinde değerlendirilir ve dalın genel anlamına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşüncenin, sözün ya da durumun gerçekten var olana uygun düşmesi ve bu nedenle yanlışın karşısında doğru, sağlam ve kesin sayılmasıdır. Söz bakımından ayrıca eğretilemenin karşısındaki gerçek anlamı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gerçekte var olana uygun düşen şey doğru ve sağlamdır.
Bir konuyu araştırıp doğruluğundan kesin biçimde emin olma bu çekirdeğin bilgi alanındaki uzantısıdır.
Bir sözün eğretileme olmadan ilk konulduğu anlamda kullanılması, dil alanındaki özel görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, yanlışın karşısındaki doğruluğu gerçekliğe uygunlukla açıklar; kesin olarak öğrenmeyi ve sözün eğretilemesiz gerçek anlamını da aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düşüncenin, sözün veya durumun gerçekten var olana uygun ve yanlışın karşıtı olduğunu bütün çekirdeğiyle anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçekliğe uygunluk, doğruluk ve kesinlik öğelerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün ya da yargının yanlış olmadığını belirten günlük bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Kesin bilgi ile gerçek anlam kullanımını tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün eğretileme değil, ilk ve doğrudan anlamında kullanıldığını belirtirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dilsel kullanımın eğretilemesiz ve yerli yerinde oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel doğruluk ve kesin bilgi yönlerini kapsamaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحق نقيض الباطل، والصحة، واليقين، والحقيقة، ومطابقة الاعتقاد أو القول أو الفعل لما هو ثابت.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinde tarafların çekişmesi, her birinin doğrunun veya payın kendisinde olduğunu ileri sürmesi ve kimi kullanımda bir tarafın üstün gelmesi açıkça yer alır. Dal kimliği bu karşılıklı yapıyı doğru verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı çekişme türemiş biçimlerde görülür; küçük işler üzerinde çok çekişmeyi anlatan söz öbeği yalnız o özel kullanımda korunur.

concept_map.definition: İki ya da daha çok tarafın aynı konuda doğru tarafın veya istenen payın kendilerinde olduğunu ileri sürerek birbirleriyle çekişmesidir. Süreç, bir tarafın savını kabul ettirip üstün gelmesiyle sonuçlanabilir.

facets.statement: Taraflar karşılıklı olarak çekişir ve her biri kendi savının doğru olduğunu ileri sürer.
Çekişmenin sonunda bir tarafın savını kabul ettirerek ötekine üstün gelmesi olası sonuçtur.
Önemsiz ve küçük konularda durmadan çekişme, kalıba bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, karşılıklı çekişmeyi tarafların doğrunun kendilerinde olduğunu ileri sürmesiyle açıklar; üstün gelme ve küçük işler üzerinde aşırı çekişme bunun özel yönleridir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın aynı payın kendilerine ait olduğunu ileri sürerek tartıştığı bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.loses: Doğruluk savının daha geniş alanını ve üstün gelme sonucunu kapsamaz.

branches.branch_image_ar: محاقة يدعي كل طرف فيها الحق
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حاقه وحاققته وتحاق القوم واحتقوا، أي تخاصموا وادعى كل واحد أن الحق معه، ومنه نزق الحقاق.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حاق فلان فلانا إذا ادعى كل واحد منهما (maqayis)؛ حاقه أي خاصمه، والتحاق التخاصم والاحتقاق الاختصام (sihah)؛ تحاق القوم واحتقوا إذا تخاصموا (tahdhib)؛ حاققته فحققته أي خاصمته في الحق فغلبته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız başkasına kanıt göstermeyi değil, bir konudan kesin olarak emin olmayı, bir söz veya sanıyı doğrulamayı, doğru olduğunu bildirmeyi ve doğru diye belirlemeyi de içerir. Dal korunabilir, ancak gösterme işlemi bu daha geniş doğrulama alanının yalnız bir yönüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Türemiş biçimlerin doğrulama ve kesinleştirme yönleri birlikte korunur; söz ve sanı nesneleriyle kurulan özel kalıp bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir konunun doğru olduğunu araştırıp kesin olarak belirlemek, doğru diye onaylamak veya kanıtlarla görünür kılmaktır. İşlem kişinin kendi kesinliğe ulaşmasından bir savı başkasına kabul ettirmesine kadar uzanabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin doğru olduğunu belirleyip onu doğru diye onaylama işlemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Araştırma sonunda kişinin kendisinin kesinliğe ulaşması işlemin bilgi yönüdür.
Doğruluğu kanıtlarla açığa çıkarıp bir savı geçerli kılma işlemin gösterme yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, kesin olarak öğrenme, bir söz veya sanıyı doğrulama, doğru olduğunu bildirme ve kanıtlayarak geçerli kılma işlemlerini ortak bir doğrulama alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir konunun doğru olduğundan emin olma, onu onaylama ve gerektiğinde kanıtla görünür kılma sürecini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirleme, kesinleşme, onaylama ve kanıtla gösterme yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün, sanının veya bilginin doğru olduğunu inceleyip onaylama bağlamlarında en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğu belirleyip onaylama işleminin temel yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişisel kesinliğe ulaşma ile kanıtları görünür kılma yönlerini açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir savın kanıtlarla ortaya konup geçerli kılındığı tartışma veya yargı bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğu başkasına görünür kılma ve geçerli saydırma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalnız kişinin kendi kesinliğe ulaşması yönünü kapsamaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أحققت وحققت بمعنى أثبت الحق أو حكمت بكونه حقا أو صدقت القول، وإحقاق الحق بإظهار الأدلة أو إكمال الأمر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حققت الأمر وأحققته أي كنت على يقين منه (maqayis)؛ حققت قوله وظنه تحقيقا أي صدقت (sihah)؛ حقق الرجل إذا قال هذا الشيء هو الحق (tahdhib)؛ أحققت كذا أي أثبته حقا أو حكمت بكونه حقا، ليحق الحق (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحاقة اسما للقيامة أو الساعة لأنها تحق الأمور أو تحق كل إنسان بعمله أو يحق فيها الجزاء.
يدخل فيه حقيقة الرجل وما يحق عليه أن يحميه أو يلزمه الدفاع عنه، ومعه الراية والحرمة والفناء حيث نصت المصادر.
يدخل فيه الحق والحقة من الإبل إذا استكمل الثالثة ودخل في الرابعة واستحق الحمل أو الركوب، وحق اللقاح ووقت الضرب، وسمن الناقة أو المال عند تمام الربيع حيث نصت المصادر.
يدخل فيه الطعنة المحتقة والطعن النافذ إلى الجوف أو الذي لا زيغ فيه، وما يقابله المشرم الذي يجرح ولا ينفذ.

branches.branch_image_ar: إحكام رصين في نسج أو كلام
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الثوب المحقق المحكم النسج، والكلام المحقق الرصين، وإحكام الشيء وتصحيحه.
يدخل فيه الحق ملتقى العظمين أو حق الورك والوابلة، والحقة من خشب أو عاج، وحق الباب، وحاق الرأس أو الشتاء بمعنى الوسط، وحق الكهول بمعنى بيت العنكبوت.
يدخل فيه الحقحقة في السير، أي الشدة التي تتعب الظهر أو تحمل الضعيف على ما لا يطيق.
يدخل فيه أحقت أو استحقت الناقة سمنا أو لقاحا، وأحق القوم إذا سمن مالهم، واحتق المال إذا انتهى سمنه.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القربان ما قرب إلى الله تعالى من نسيكة أو غيرها (maqayis)؛ ما له عند الله قربة والقربان الأضاحي وكل ما تقرب إلى الله فهو قربان (jamhara)؛ القربان ما تقربت به إلى الله وتقرب إلى الله بشيء طلب به القربة (sihah)؛ القربان ما قربت إلى الله تبتغي بذلك قربة ووسيلة وهي ذبائح كانوا يذبحونها (tahdhib)؛ القربان ما يتقرب به إلى الله وصار اسما للنسيكة التي هي الذبيحة والقربة قربات عند الله (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القرب الذي يفسر بالرعاية والإجابة والإفضال والقدرة والقرب الروحاني لا قرب المكان
يدخل فيه قرب الأمر أو الشيء بمعنى ملابسته ومشارفته والنهي عن قرب المحظور وقربان المرأة كناية عن الجماع
يدخل فيه سير القوم والإبل نحو الماء عند قرب الورد وليلة القرب والقارب طالب الماء ليلا والعجلة والسوق الشديد إلى المورد
يدخل فيه القربة التي يستقى فيها الماء وجمعها قرب وقربات
يدخل فيه قراب السيف والسكين والجراب أو الجلد الذي يكون فيه السيف وجعل السيف في القراب
يدخل فيه القارب وهو سفينة صغيرة تتبع السفن أو تكون مع أصحاب السفن لحوائجهم
يدخل فيه الشاة والفرس والمرأة والأتان إذا دنا نتاجها أو ولادها وصارت مقربا أو مقربة
يدخل فيه الفرس أو الخيل المقربة التي تدنى وتكرم أو تعد للركوب والإبل المقربة المحزومة أو ذات الرحل
يدخل فيه تقريب الفرس وهو ضرب من العدو دون الحضر وله أدنى وأعلى أو رفع اليدين ووضعهما معا
يدخل فيه قرب الفرس أو الإنسان بمعنى الكشح والخاصرة وما بين الشاكلة ومراق البطن ووضع اليد على القرب
يدخل فيه قراب الشيء وما يقارب ملأه أو عدده أو زمنه والقدح القربان والإناء الكربان والثوب أو الشيء المقارب بين الجودة والرداءة أو في الثمن

error_profile.preserves: Düşmanlık ve denk rakiplik seçeneklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşıdaki kişinin düşmanlığı veya eski bir öç ilişkisi içinde oluşu vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşıtlık ve düşmanlık yönünü doğal bir adla korur.
error_profile.loses: Düşmanlık taşımayan denk kişi veya benzer anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişinin güç, konum ya da karşılaşma bakımından birbirine denk olduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Denklik, karşılıklılık ve rakiplik yönlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Açık düşmanlık ve öç ilişkisini zorunlu olarak bildirmez.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القتل العدو وجمعه أقتال (maqayis;sihah)؛ قوم أقتال أي أهل الوتر والترة أي أعداء ذوي ترات (ayn)؛ فلان قتل فلان أي نظيره وابن عمه (jamhara)؛ الأقتال الأعداء واحدهم قتل وهم الأقران (tahdhib)؛ القتل العدو والقرن (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القتال بمعنى النفس أو بقية الجسم، وناقة ذات قتال إذا كانت وثيقة أو غليظة الخلق.
يدخل فيه قاتلهم الله، قتل الإنسان، وقتل الخراصون حين تفسر بالدعاء عليهم أو اللعن أو العداوة.
يدخل فيه قاتل فلان فلانا، المقاتلة، القتال، الاقتتال، وتقاتل القوم حين يكون بين طرفين أو أكثر مع تحري القتل.
يدخل فيه استقتل بمعنى استمات.
يدخل فيه قولهم هو قاتل الشتوات، أي يطعم فيها ويدفئ الناس.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel koruma çekirdeğini özel ad ve kalıplardan ayırır; kadına ait koruyucu bez yalnızca yapıya bağlı bir örnek olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ona zarar verecek başka bir şeyden korumak için araya bir araç ya da engel koyma ve böylece zararı ondan uzak tutma. Bu işlevi gören araç veya engel de aynı kavram alanında adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Korunan şeyden zarar verici etkiyi uzak tutma ve onu incinmekten ya da bozulmaktan saklama işlemidir.
Koruma, zarar ile korunacak şey arasına başka bir araç, katman veya engel koyularak gerçekleştirilir.
Kadının saçı ile dış örtüsü arasına koyduğu bez, bu koruyucu ara katmanın özel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, korumayı zararlı etkiyi başka bir şey aracılığıyla savma olarak kurar; hem koruma eylemini hem de bu işte kullanılan engeli kapsar. Kadının saçını dış örtüden ayıran bez, bu mekanizmanın özel bir örneğidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel eylem ile koruyucu aracın ortak çekirdeğini, herhangi bir özel kullanım alanına bağlamadan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Zararı uzak tutma işlemini ve araya koruyucu bir unsur koyma mekanizmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemden çok, zarar ile korunacak şey arasına koyulan araç veya katman kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Araya koyulan unsurun koruyucu işlevini ve zararı kesen konumunu korur.

The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

source_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

tier_contracts.explicit_interest: Full source branch payload, except fields removed from all tiers.
tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
